Authorize and durably start the quoted workflow once. Preserve action_id, revision, quote_id and max_credits. One workflow charge includes up to three total attempts; tool free uses do not apply. The server completes all declared steps and saves library results. Wait with pixelbank_read action wait_for_workflow when available, without further writes; direct clients without that action poll pixelbank_get_workflow_status {run_id}.

availability: Use the authenticated tools/list response for actual availability and granted authority.

tools.description: Permanently delete exactly one owned image, animation or workflow run, only after the creator explicitly asked; confirmed must be true. Pass the action's arguments object as arguments. Before an unfamiliar action call pixelbank_read describe {arguments:{action}}. Outline (? optional): delete_asset{asset,confirmed}; delete_animation{confirmed,id}; delete_workflow{confirmed,run_id}.
tools.name: pixelbank_delete

tools.description: Change owned library items and saved workflows without processing or charges. Pass the action's arguments object as arguments. Before an unfamiliar action call pixelbank_read describe {arguments:{action}}. Outline (? optional): prepare_workspace{canvas?,layers,operation_key,prompt?,tool,workflow?}; update_asset_tags{asset,tags}; save_cutout{image}; recompose_animation{id,request{disabled_indices}}; update_animation_tags{id,request{tags}}; create_workflow{definition_key,operation_key}; update_workflow{action,run_id}; import_workflow_source{request{action_id,image,revision,step_key},run_id}.

tools.description: Read workflow progress without processing. Follow poll_after_seconds; stop when pollable is false.
tools.name: pixelbank_get_workflow_status

tools.description: Read an owned prepared workspace and its current web URL. Opening is handled by the installed bridge.
tools.name: pixelbank_get_workspace

tools.description: Issue a purpose-bound direct image upload. The local upload helper consumes this ticket without putting credentials in the conversation.
tools.name: pixelbank_issue_upload

tools.description: Read the Pixelbank account, owned images, animations, jobs, upscaling and workflow quotes, and saved workflows. Nothing is changed, charged or counted. Pass the action's arguments object as arguments. describe {arguments:{action}} returns an action's exact schema; call it before an unfamiliar action. Outline (? optional): get_account; list_assets{cursor?,limit?,namespace,tag?}; get_asset{filename,namespace}; quote_upscaling{factor,mode,source}; get_job{job_id,kind}; list_animations{cursor?,limit?}; get_animation{id}; list_animation_jobs; list_workflow_definitions; list_workflows{cursor?,limit?,status?}; get_workflow{run_id}; get_workflow_activity{run_id}; quote_workflow{request?,run_id}; describe{action?}.
tools.name: pixelbank_read

tools.description: Start billable processing. Keep operation_key and the approved maximum unchanged across retries of one request; it is charged at most once. Pass the action's arguments object as arguments. Before an unfamiliar action call pixelbank_read describe {arguments:{action}}. Paid actions (!) also take operation_key, maximum_credits, optional paid_fallback_credits and workflow. Outline (? optional): remove_background!{request{image}}; segment!{request{image,selection}}; segment_and_save!{request{image,selection}}; generate_image!{request{options}}; generate_animation!{request{options,start_image}}; upscale_image!{request{factor,mode,quote,source}}; correct_animation_frame!{request{animation_id,correction,frame_index}}; execute_workflow{request{action_id,max_credits,revision},run_id}.
tools.name: pixelbank_run

tools.description: Persist a verified workflow-input upload as an owned source for prepared web workspaces. No image-processing job starts.
tools.name: pixelbank_save_source
